summary: Join our Construction Project Management in Oil and Gas training course to develop key skills and knowledge for successful project execution in the field.
lede: Project management in oil and gas helps project and construction professionals plan and control complex construction work. The course covers practical ways to define scope, build schedules and cost baselines, manage contractors and changes, assess risks, integrate HSE and quality into execution, and coordinate site activities through commissioning and handover.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals directly or indirectly responsible for planning, supervising, or governing construction and installation works in the oil and gas sector.
audience: Project managers and project engineers in oil
Engineering managers and discipline leads (civil, mechanical
Owners’ representatives and client-side project teams
Operations or maintenance staff engaged in brownfield
modules: Oil and Gas Project Lifecycle and Context
Defining Scope and Work Breakdown in Construction Projects
Planning and Scheduling for Complex Energy Projects
Cost Estimation, Budgeting, and Change Control
HSE and Quality Management in Construction Projects
Risk Management and Uncertainty in Project Delivery
Field Execution, Logistics, and Site Coordination
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of project management principles and some experience in the oil and gas sector.
